id: \bI found this while I was fishing a while ago.
en: \bI found this while I was fishing a while ago.
it: \bHo trovato questo mentre pescavo, tempo fa.

id: \bI suppose I can give you this one. I already have one.
en: \bI suppose I can give you this one. I already have one.
it: \bPotrei darlo a te. Io ne ho già uno.

id: \bI might find a rare catch soon.
en: \bI might find a rare catch soon.

id: \rHow do all those Pokémon hide in the grass?
en: \rHow do all those Pokémon hide in the grass?
it: \rCome fanno tutti quei Pokémon a nascondersi nell'erba?

id: \bIsn't the Space Center so cool? I visit it all the time!
en: \bIsn't the Space Center so cool? I visit it all the time!
it: \bIl Centro Spaziale non è fantastico? Ci vado di continuo!

id: Mossdeep City Pokémon Gym Leaders: \nLiza & Tate
en: Mossdeep City Pokémon Gym Leaders: \nLiza & Tate
it: Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Verdeazzupoli: \nTell & Pat

id: \rI used to travel across the sea all the time. If only I was young again.
en: \rI used to travel across the sea all the time. If only I was young again.
it: \rUn tempo viaggiavo per mare in continuazione. Ah, se fossi ancora giovane.

id: \bI'm only taking you back to Lilycove. Do you want to go or what?
en: \bI'm only taking you back to Lilycove. Do you want to go or what?
it: \bTi riporto solo a Porto Alghepoli. Vuoi andarci o no?

id: \bWell fine. I didn't want to go anyways.
en: \bWell fine. I didn't want to go anyways.
it: \bE va bene. Tanto non volevo andarci.

id: \bYou want me to take you to Sootopolis City? I suppose I can give it a try. Are you ready?
en: \bYou want me to take you to Sootopolis City? I suppose I can give it a try. Are you ready?
it: \bVuoi che ti porti a Ceneride? Posso provarci. Sei pronto?

id: \bOh well if you ever feel like it.
en: \bOh well if you ever feel like it.

id: \bYou want me to take you to Izabe Island? I suppose I can give it a try. Are you ready?
en: \bYou want me to take you to Izabe Island? I suppose I can give it a try. Are you ready?
it: \bVuoi che ti porti sull'Isola Izabe? Posso provarci. Sei pronto?

id: \bThe waves are powerful, but I am stronger.
en: \bThe waves are powerful, but I am stronger.
it: \bLe onde sono potenti, ma io sono più forte.

id: \bI can pass some of this strength off to a Pokémon if you wish.
en: \bI can pass some of this strength off to a Pokémon if you wish.
it: \bPosso trasmettere un po' di questa forza a un Pokémon, se vuoi.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach Dynamic Punch?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach Dynamic Punch?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che insegni Dinamipugno?

id: \bYou want go to Sootopolis City? I think there is a psychic around here somewhere that can take you there.
en: \bYou want go to Sootopolis City? I think there is a psychic around here somewhere that can take you there.
it: \bVuoi andare a Ceneride? Credo che qui in giro ci sia un sensitivo che può portartici.

id: \bThere are a lot of rare space Pokémon out in the world. I heard Deoxys is one of them.
en: \bThere are a lot of rare space Pokémon out in the world. I heard Deoxys is one of them.
it: \bNel mondo ci sono tanti rari Pokémon venuti dallo spazio. Ho sentito che Deoxys è uno di questi.

id: \rI got tired of swimming. I wish he would quit so we could go home.
en: \rI got tired of swimming. I wish he would quit so we could go home.
it: \rMi sono stancata di nuotare. Vorrei che smettesse, così potremmo tornare a casa.
